messages:
nina: Heads-up: after the midnight RBAC cleanup some regions saw mTLS errors and failed session resume. Looks like KMS unwrap denied for ticket keys in ap-south and us-east-1.
omar: timeline? which policy change?
rbac-bot: policy-clean-#310 applied 2026-03-24T00:11Z. Diff: removed member serviceAccount:svc-keystore-legacy@infra, added serviceAccount:svc-keystore-v2@infra.
claudia: we rolled the new keystore identity but a subset of rotators in ap-south still run with the legacy identity. KMS denies match that. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-24T00:18:02Z keystore ap-south ERROR kms: DecryptDenied key=arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:444555666:key/tt-99 principal=svc-keystore-legacy@infra
2026-03-24T00:18:05Z proxy-edge ap-south ERROR tls: session_resume failed: ticket_unwrap_error
```
nina: mitigation path?
omar: short: re-grant unwrap to legacy principal for 25m and restart rotators to pick up new SA. long: update RBAC automation to do overlap window on principal swaps.
claudia: added quick patch in ap-south with aws kms put-key-policy and restarted rotators at 00:26Z; unwraps now succeed. Example success: 
```
2026-03-24T00:26:31Z keystore ap-south INFO kms: unwrap OK key=tt-99 principal=svc-keystore-legacy@infra
2026-03-24T00:26:33Z proxy-edge ap-south INFO tls: session_resume OK client=svc-ingest
```
nina: we need better observability: when KMS denies happen, include `principal`, `keyId`, `policy_commit` and `rbac_change_id` in the security alerts so we can quickly correlate to commits.
omar: agree. I'll add a small forwarder rule and an alert enrichment that pulls `rbac_change_id` from policy metadata if present.
claudia: also propose adding a pre-prune check in automation: list active service identities across regions for keys referenced and block destructive prune if multiple principals detected unless `--force` is set.
nina: add runbook item: when swapping keystore identities, create a 30m additive binding window and run smoke checks that verify ticket unwrap across all regions. Smoke check example: `curl -H "x-upgrade-check: keystore" https://proxy-edge.ap-south/health` and validate unwrap log entry within 60s.
infra-bot: incident created INC-20260324-03. Assigned: nina, omar. Priority: P2.
omar: postmortem owners: nina (mitigation + logging), claudia (automation overlap), infra (CI smoke check). I'll open the vuln triage for the RBAC diff and attach the commit id.
claudia: follow-ups: - add overlap flag to RBAC tool - patch log forwarder to surface principal/key id - add pre-prune region-scan block - add smoke check to RBAC CI
nina: containment verified at 00:35Z. moving to postmortem. :white_check_mark:
